name: Desire: Girls with no Dreams
source:
Follow Mirian, a young woman tormented by confusing memories and increasingly lasting  'crises'  that make her feel like a monster. 

Fearing that one day she would no longer be herself, she becomes involved in a conflict for a possible cure, interacting with other survivors along the way.

[From [url=https://desire-gwnd.itch.io/dgwnd-demo]itch.io[/url]]
